documents.doc-cz-fnol-2026-08-19-stl2015-11-prepra: Olomouc University Hospital provided, in response to the request concerning transport of blood, recommendation STL2015_11 on storage and transport of blood, blood components, starting material for further manufacture and blood products.
documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-08-19-8-ad-9-2026-80: The Prague Municipal Court forwarded to the claimant, for information, the Ministry of Health’s statement of defence and its supplement in the intervention action.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-20-replika-8-ad-9-2026: The claimant filed a reply to the Ministry of Health’s statement and supplement, requesting urgent determination without requesting a public hearing.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-19-doplneni-18-a-23-20: An exceptionally urgent supplement to the action submitted further documentary evidence concerning the alleged continuing arbitrariness, reversal of institutional responsibility and continuation of the challenged interference.
documents.doc-cz-msz-pha-2026-08-20-2-kzn-55-2025-: The Prague Municipal Public Prosecutor’s Office dealt with filings dated 25 April, 10, 12 and 27 May, 2 and 4 June, and 15 and 19 July 2026; it found no reason to exercise the power under Section 157(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and placed the specified filings on file without further action.
documents.doc-cz-pcr-ku-2026-08-20-ku-4139-12-cj-2: The Institute of Criminalistics stated that it was unaware of any error in forensic work, that the quality of forensic work is monitored through methodological and expert visits, and that it was not obliged, at the applicant’s request, to review forensic procedures and methods used in expert work.
documents.doc-cz-pcr-krpt-2026-08-20-krpt-203594-7: The Moravian-Silesian Regional Police Directorate partially answered the freedom-of-information request concerning SOPs and methodological documentation used by the Frýdek-Místek forensic unit in 2009–2019, providing a representative-sampling methodology and a list of methodological visits and destruction records.
documents.doc-cz-pcr-krpt-2026-08-20-rr-ku-54-2021: Annex to ref. KRPT-203594-7/ČJ-2026-0700KR: Director of the Institute of Criminalistics Order No. 54/2021 on the examination of cannabis and cannabinoids.
Annex to ref. KRPT-203594-7/ČJ-2026-0700KR: methodology for taking a representative sample of plant material, Annex 1 to Director’s Order No. 54/2021.
documents.doc-cz-pcr-krpt-2026-08-20-metodicko-odb: Annex to ref. KRPT-203594-7/ČJ-2026-0700KR: list of files concerning methodological and expert visits, inter-laboratory tests and destruction records from 2009–2019.
documents.doc-cz-pcr-krpt-2026-08-20-krpt-203594-8: Decision partially refusing the freedom-of-information request: the Police stated that in 2009–2019 the Frýdek-Místek forensic unit had no SOPs for determining THC, no written methodological instructions for homogenisation or determination of THC/THCA, no methodology for measurement uncertainty and no validation protocols; some control files had been destroyed after retention periods expired.
documents.doc-cz-pcr-pp-2026-08-24-ppr-44020-2-cj-: The Internal Control Office of the Police Presidium declined superior review under Section 97(3) of the Police Act on the ground that the preceding mandatory examination under Section 97 had not taken place at the Institute of Criminalistics, and placed the filing of 15 August 2026 on file without further action.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-21-mv-druhe-nalehave-d: Second urgent supplement to the complaints to the Minister of the Interior, relying on the Police records of 20 August 2026, identifying discrepancies in historical methodological documentation and requesting immediate preservation of the remaining evidence.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-21-ms-praha-15-a-44-20: Further urgent evidentiary supplement in case 15 A 44/2026, relying on the Police records of 20 August 2026, conflicting statements concerning historical SOPs and ENFSI-UNODC guidance, and documented destruction of part of the records.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-22-os-prostejov-2-t-10: Exceptionally urgent supplement to the application to reopen proceedings in case 2 T 104/2010, submitting the new official Police records of 20 August 2026.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-22-nsz-sedme-doplneni-: Seventh supplement to the pre-action demand of 14 July 2026 and a disciplinary submission concerning the handling by JUDr. Lenka Chmelová, based on the new official Police records of 20 August 2026.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-24-vsz-praha-prezkum-m: Request to the Prague High Public Prosecutor’s Office to review the Prague Municipal Public Prosecutor’s handling of 20 August 2026 and an exceptionally urgent evidentiary supplement in supervision branch 1 VZN 1678/2026.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-24-policejni-prezident: Urgent supplement to the request for review addressed to the Police President, relying on the records of 20 and 24 August 2026 and requesting an impartial review and preservation of evidence.
documents.doc-cz-dd-2026-08-24-gibs-doplneni-trest: Exceptionally urgent supplement to the criminal report submitted to the General Inspection of Security Forces on 15 August 2026, adding official records from 20–24 August and again requesting immediate preservation of laboratory, methodological and control documentation.
